editorial:
You know that feeling when summer is winding down and everything feels a little heavier? That's the mood this Italian drama captures from the very first scene. Set against the golden light of late summer, it follows a family gathering at a countryside home where old tensions slowly bubble to the surface. The pacing is unhurried, letting you sit with the characters as small conversations turn into big revelations. It's the kind of movie that rewards patience, pulling you into its warm but complicated world without rushing to explain everything.

The acting is natural and understated, with performances that feel lived-in rather than performed. The cinematography makes great use of natural light, giving every scene a soft, nostalgic glow. On the downside, the slow burn won't work for everyone, and a few subplots fade out without full resolution. Still, if you enjoy character-driven stories that trust you to read between the lines, this is a rewarding watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the family dinner erupts into an honest confrontation where long-held secrets come out. The eldest sibling reveals they've been carrying the weight of a past mistake that shaped everyone's lives. Rather than a neat fix, the movie ends with the family sitting together in silence as summer fades, suggesting healing will take time. The twist is that the quietest character had known the truth all along and chose forgiveness over anger.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character-driven family dramas and quiet, thoughtful storytelling.
